name: Customer Search-to-Purchase Path Attribution (Session Query Lift)
description: E-commerce search product managers need to know which search queries drove actual revenue. We link search queries to checkout events within the same 30-minute session.
prompt:
E-commerce search product managers need to know which search queries drove actual revenue. We link search queries to checkout events within the same 30-minute session.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: order_id, user_id, order_total, attributing_search_query, searched_at, ordered_at.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Attribute purchase to the most recent search query prior to order
            SELECT 
                o.order_id,
                o.user_id,
                o.order_total,
                s.query_term AS attributing_search_query,
                s.searched_at,
                o.ordered_at
            FROM completed_orders o
            ASOF JOIN user_search_queries s
              ON o.user_id = s.user_id
             AND o.ordered_at >= s.searched_at
            ORDER BY o.order_id;
why_it_fails: Attributing purchases to search queries that occurred after the purchase order was placed.
